this function reference isn't stable, meaning it won't be the same between renders. You can set it once like in search box and other widgets

no need to merge search parameters here, it won't work with relevancyStrictness

you can do setQueryParameter / getQueryParameter, no?

is this meant to be the default strictness? 

I think it's meant to toggle between:

1. undefined (100 set by the engine)
2. user-provided value (default to 0)

I see two cases:

1. smartSort({ }); // no explicit relevancyStrictness
-> Clicking "See all results" set 0 to suppress it.
-> Clicking "See relevant results" set undefined to fallback to the value in the index configuration.

2. smartSort({ relevancyStrictness: xx });
-> Clicking "See all results" set 0 to suppress it.
-> Clicking "See relevant results" go back to the value in the widgetParams.

What do you think?

I think by applying the relevancyStrictness by default, we are forcing relevancyStrictness on non-smart sort indices, does that have any undefined behaviour? 

I find it a little odd that this widget would apply the parameter when it shouldn't display.

Possibly this is because we're missing a condition:

normal index: display nothing
smart index (appliedRelevancyStrictness is set):
- appliedRelevancyStrictness === 0: isSmartSorted: false
- appliedRelevancyStrictness !== 0: isSmartSorted: true

what do you think?
I still think that having this default strictness could pose problems for detecting which state we are in. I think it should stay being set in the settings only
I had a sync and we're good to remove `relevancyStrictness` from the widget parameter to the component altogether. I had a wrong understanding that it was a part of the spec. I'll update it tomorrow.

In the updated version, I didn't remove the ability to apply relevancyStrictness altogether. I just removed the widget parameter. The component still gets `refine` function and call either `refine(0)` or `refine(undefined)` to toggle the status. https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/4648/commits/2f3409f316f62b53052b3aeeb1e3ee18a67c7573
